Today, I’ll be sharing my top 7 lessons that I learned to create freedom in your life.

1. Follow Your Path

When you’re not doing what you’re supposed to be doing, the universe will tell you that you’re not on the right path.

2. Take You Time

It takes time and hard work, don’t think that in a weeks time you’ll get 100K of passive income. Pace it out, don’t over work yourself, and take your time.

3. Let It Grow

You have to remember that you need to take breaks and get away. Once you’re back from your break, you’ll then realize that your business has been growing so just let it grow and take your time.

Another tip is to listen to podcasts which have helped me with my business so well!

4. Learn From Others

Others have done it. They have succeeded and failed so learn from them. This is the main reason why I created this YouTube channel. And it was to help people with their own ecommerce business.

5. Hire Help

Sure you can do everything yourself, but keep in mind that you’ll be doing a lot of work. So hire a virtual assistant to help you. It will help triple your productivity and it’s only $3 an hour.

6. Fill A Need

You have to be able to answer the question ‘What Makes Your Company Unique’. If you can’t, don’t even start a business. One way to do this is if you think of something that doesn’t exist yet that people need.

7. Scratch Your Own Itch

It’s so much easier to make a product and a business when you’re passionate about and when you yourself is the niche!


Remember: Create a Product, Create a Freedom!
